text:
alex_finance: Quick ask — procurement wants a head-to-head on QuantaLedger vs QuantaLogic for ML billing. Can someone surface pricing quirks and invoice gotchas? cc @sasha_procurement @jamie_engineering

sasha_procurement: Do we want committed-tier quotes or purely pay-as-you-go comparisons? committed more relevant if we consider Dedicated.

jamie_engineering: For our prod profile: ~5M gen tokens/mo, ~200k embeddings/mo, bursty QPS around EOD. Generation ~60% of tokens. Put a small sample of 7-day qps below.

jamie_engineering: ```
date,qps_gen,qps_embed
2026-02-12,42,5
2026-02-13,88,12
2026-02-14,35,8
```

alex_finance: Audit asked about meter drift/rounding on invoices — do either vendors round up to next 1000 tokens or bill exact? Also: how do they show per-SKU breakdown on the invoice?

quantalogger_bot: QuantaLedger invoice (sample) uploaded: https://s3.redwood.test/quantaledger/sample-invoice-jan.pdf :file_folder:

nora_audit: From first glance: QuantaLedger shows line items per "model+sku" but aggregates hourly buckets. Need to confirm whether they backfill retroactively when billing adjustments occur.

sasha_procurement: QuantaLogic quoted a 10% discount on committed 6mo if we commit to 2 reserved nodes. They also have an overage cap option (we can cap at 120% of committed spend). QuantaLedger proposed tiered per-token pricing with a monthly true-up.

jamie_engineering: Important: QuantaLedger treats embeddings as a separate SKU (per-request), QuantaLogic charges per-vector which changes effective cost for our 512-d embeddings. Need vendor confirmation on vector->call mapping.

alex_finance: Can someone do a quick 6-month TCO with assumptions: 5M gen tokens/mo, 200k embeddings/mo, 2% month-over-month growth, and include likely committed discounts? We just need back-of-envelope.

sasha_procurement: On it — will draft spreadsheet and flag contract clauses: audit rights, invoice dispute window (QuantaLedger: 30 days, QuantaLogic: 45 days), and cancellation notice (both want 60 days).

maria_englead: Also ask about throttling and surge pricing. If they throttle sustained QPS, our latency SLO suffers — require burst guarantees or burst capacity add-on.

alex_finance: Good call. Also confirm SLA credits and whether credits reduce invoice $ or are applied as future credit. Legal prefers immediate invoice adjustment if material.

quantalogger_bot: QuantaLedger support replied: "We bill to exact token granularity, hourly buckets; invoice adjustments within 30 days. Embedding calls billed per-request (not per-vector)."

nora_audit: Keep a note: if they bill per-request for embeddings, we might save on vector-dense calls but lose on batched pipelines. Add a quick sensitivity row in the sheet.

sasha_procurement: Draft ready — I uploaded comparison sheet: https://docs.redwood/quanta-vs-quanta-ledger-tco (will share with finance/legal). Planning vendor follow-up this week with contract redlines.

alex_finance: Perfect. Once you have vendor answers on overage caps, dispute windows, and embedding mapping, paste them here. Thx :thumbsup:
